reviews.author: Juhi
reviews.text: Dean was fantastic! He arrived on time, was professional and super friendly! We used Apache HVAC for cleaning out our dryer & vents. He explained everything in detail & even gave us helpful tips to keep things running safely and efficiently. Great to have someone so reliable & courteous. Highly recommend Dean for anyone needing HVAC service.

reviews.author: Tony S.
reviews.text: Just wanted to say how grateful I am to Dean and his company for coming through in a clutch. Dean was at capacity with jobs the week I called him for service but unlike other companies that would just leave you stranded Dean actually helped me out remotely and walked me through how to resolve the issue, he’s the best! I’ve used Apache previously and will continue to use and recommend them to others, because they’re professional and efficient and will get the job done! Thanks again Dean for the help!

reviews.author: geeti h
reviews.text: I recently had my vents cleaned by Dean, and I couldn't be more impressed with the service. From start to finish, he was professional, punctual, and extremely thorough. He took the time to explain the entire process, answered all my questions, and made sure everything was spotless before he left. You can tell Dean takes pride in his work, he even showed before-and-after photos of the inside of the ducts, which was both shocking and satisfying to see. If you're considering getting your vents cleaned, I highly recommend giving Dean a call. He’s knowledgeable, trustworthy, and delivers excellent results at a fair price. Thanks again, Dean! The difference in air quality is night and day.

reviews.author: Ron Orsi
reviews.text: Dean replaced the entire 20 year old HVAC system in my townhouse including custom duct work, new ecobee thermostats, rewiring, adding a 3rd zone, gas furnace, and outside condenser unit as well as the pad. The installation was complicated by the 4th floor location of the furnace/ducting and the ground floor condenser location but he engineered and installed a proper high quality solution. He was professional, kept me informed during the entire process and charged a fair price. I've been doing business with Dean for over 15 years and wouldn't hesitate to hire him again in the future.

reviews.author: nick nieves
reviews.text: Apache Air Solutions has been great over the many years we've used them. Dean in particular has provided excellent service for more than fair prices. Furthermore, he has numerously made quick, short-notice visits when my hot water heater blew and a/c needed to be serviced. I would highly recommend them to anyone in need of HVAC services and plan to use them for any future issues that arise!

reviews.author: Law
reviews.text: I've had excellent experiences with Dean at Apache. He's responsive and calls you day of to confirm the time frame and let you know when he's on his way. He's repaired my central AC unit and cleaned my dryer vent twice. Additionally, he's giving me tips to help maintain my dryer and AC.

reviews.author: Bobby Angus
reviews.text: I used Dean for a vent installation for a dryer. Dean was professional, responsive, and thorough in his explanation. We bought our new unit from Pc Richards in Wayne and they left us in a bind. Dean came in assessed the situation and fixed the problem in 2 hours. We will be offering Dean all of our business for HVAC going forward.

reviews.author: Dana Cittrich
reviews.text: Dean & his team were so great. He is reliable and dependable and really took his time to help me understand everything that needed to be done with my system. He gave me a date and a time frame and was there when he said he would be. He was not only efficient but extremely professional and personable. I highly recommend this company and will be using them again for all of my heating and cooling needs. Thanks again !!

reviews.author: Sanjiv Patel
reviews.text: Dean and the team showed up on time to clean my hvac and ducts. They did I a thorough and great job. Dean was always honest about his findings. He ensured my system was put back together. They all cleaned up after themselves as well. Overall, great job. I’d recommend them.

reviews.author: Joe Rizzuto
reviews.text: Apache Air Solutions cleaned my dryer vent today and did a terrific job. They returned my call quickly. The technician was courteous, made a prompt appointment and showed up on time. They were in and out in a professional manner. I recommend them to anyone who needs HVAC service or repairs.

reviews.author: Jonathan Cameron
reviews.text: I use Apache Air to service the HVAC units in my rentals. I've had nothing but great experiences with them! Every time a tenant calls to report an issue, or when it's time to prepare for switching heat/cooling they are very responsive. For simple work, such as when one of my AC condensers leaked freon, they respond the same day, repaired the leak and charged the system. Very reasonable pricing too! Routine maintenance has to be scheduled and is based on availability but I usually get an appointment within 3 days. Also, I never get the feeling I'm being recommended equipment I don't need. Unlike most companies that look at a medium difficulty repair and just say "you need a new unit", they will actually fix the problem. On older units it may take a few repairs but it's thousands less than putting brand new systems in every time there's a little problem. Don't get burned! I highly recommend Apache Air!

reviews.author: Brinda Chauhan
reviews.text: Dean has done a number of jobs in my house - he is very professional, respectful and responsive. Very happy with the quality of the work performed. I would definitely recommend him to friends and family.

reviews.author: Jon and Fe Rivera
reviews.text: This is a long overdue review. Dean installed a brand new Airconditioning unit almost a year ago and he did check the whole system including the furnace. Our unit is still blowing cold air during summer and fall and our heater still blows hot air during winter. He’s very thorough, professional and takes the time to answer questions instead of just brushing you off. He also gave me a fair price. He could’ve said to replace the whole system (including heating furnace) but he didn’t (he could’ve made more money by doing so). Overall, a great transaction. Highly recommend his services.

reviews.author: Theresa Kircher
reviews.text: Most people don’t lay awake at night with HVAC on their minds - but when my AC broke, it was 86 degrees outside, my house was for sale and I had showings and open houses lined up, that’s EXACTLY what was on my mind. Thank god for Dean. I called him and he was able to re-arrange his schedule and come that same day to check out the problem. He put in extra time to track down the short in my system, and then did his best to fix the wiring to re-start it ASAP for our showings. When that wasn’t possible, he was able to get the necessary part and install it within 48 hours. He was extremely communicative with me throughout the entire process, and really went above and beyond to help us. He was a true lifesaver!!

reviews.author: Tyrone Acosta
reviews.text: It was the Sunday after New Years and my new Rheem furnace decided not to heat the house. The air was blowing cold. Dean fit me in the same day and came to diagnose the problem. He was was able to get the heat started but didn't stop there. He knew there was something wrong and suggested to replace a part. Thank God it was still under warranty and he helped me through the process. He got the replacement part and it was replaced the next day. Thankfully everything went smoothly with obtaining the replacement, I know sometimes that is not the case, but either way Dean was knowledgeable and cordial and was genuinely looking to help.

reviews.author: Rob Press
reviews.text: Apache Heating and Air Conditioning is nothing short of spectacular. I was having an issue with an A/C unit that had malfunctioned. When I called him, he offered me an appointment the next morning. He came exactly on time, quickly diagnosed the problem and fixed it all within 45 minutes. I am beyond impressed. On top of that, he's a genuinely kind person and honest. I only have good things to say and highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Kathy Vassallo
reviews.text: i had called regarding issues with my dryer vent, I have used there service many times before including air conditioner and heating Dean made time to come just shortly after our call. He looked through everything, explained the situation thoroughly, and was very transparent about the services required Afterwards, he took the time to walk through everything with me to prevent any future problems. I'll definitely call back in the future . I highly recommend this company

reviews.author: Lisa Levetsanos
reviews.text: Apache is prompt, dependable, courteous and extremely professional. They've done a fantastic job maintaining my AC unit, and cleaning the vents. This spring, they helped me install my window units upstairs too. Apache makes you feel like you have an HVAC pro in the family.

reviews.author: WhαttαDαy
reviews.text: Dean was able to fix our air conditioner in such a quick and easy manner! We had a a leak that was causing ceiling damage and he and Juan showed up right away to make sure that no further damage was caused. Will ABSOLUTELY use these gentlemen again! thank you guys!!

reviews.author: Kim Mitchell
reviews.text: I was the one late for my vent cleaning appointment. On time as usual, Dean was very flexible, and gave me the opportunity, to complete what i had to do. Meticulous Service as always! Kim M

reviews.author: Kev M
reviews.text: Absolute professional, very courteous and knowledgeable. Shared a lot of advice from his experience with us for which we are extremely grateful. Answered every single question we had and even added information we weren't aware of. Went totally above and beyond and delivered stella service. Grateful and Appreciative.

reviews.author: Min Son
reviews.text: We had our dryer vent cleaned and they went out of their way to make sure everything else was in good shape. Very professional and kind!! Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Roberta Hamer
reviews.text: Apache’s service is terrific. They are attentive and competitive in cost. Their service is terrific and they go the extra mile to make the customer happy. Recommend them highly.
